notes: Cai dat: tai file HPCONS-BIM-Setup-2.0.43.exe ben duoi, DONG Revit roi chay (can quyen Admin). - The "Bo tri xe tren floor bat ky" them nut "TAO NHA XE TREN FLOOR DANG CHON / CLICK CHON": dung du truc, khung cot, mai, xa go, mang xoi, up noc, diem + bo tri xe ngay tai vi tri floor trong FILE DANG MO (khong can file tong the / file mau rieng). Nut "BO TRI XE ..." (chi xe) giu nguyen. - Ranh floor = truc bien (canh dai = truc so, nha xe xoay theo floor); level = level cua floor; nen = chinh floor da chon. Bo tri xe, luoi truc, cao do, cau kien, mang - noc - diem lay dung cac buoc 2-5 cua the "Nha xe 2 banh theo tong the" (type / family phai co trong file dang mo). - Truc dat ten theo Mark cua ...
